title: Getting an EIN for a new entity
rule: An entity gets an employer identification number from the IRS online, or on Form SS-4 by fax or mail, for free. The IRS asks LLCs to form with the state first. The application names a responsible party: an individual, not an entity or nominee, who controls the entity and its funds; applying online takes that person's SSN or ITIN. Online, each responsible party gets one EIN per day. Changes of responsible party go on Form 8822-B within 60 days.

citation.authority: IRS, Instructions for Form SS-4 (Rev. December 2025), lines 7a to 7b

changeWatch: A new revision of Form SS-4 or its instructions, or changes to the IRS online EIN application.

sources.title: Instructions for Form SS-4 (Rev. December 2025)
sources.quote: the responsible party must be an individual (that is, a natural person), not an entity

sources.title: Get an employer identification number
sources.quote: You can apply for only 1 EIN per responsible party per day.
